friends.title: Friends
friends.emptyMiddle: your friends to see their travel progress, or
friends.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters of a username, or a friend's 8-character code.
friends.hiddenHint: People who turned off “find me by username” can only be added with their code or QR.
friends.cameraBody: Vromon needs the camera to read QR codes. Nothing is recorded or saved.
friends.cameraDenied: Camera access is turned off for Vromon. You can turn it on in Android settings.
friends.scanHint: Point the camera at a friend's Vromon QR code.
friends.invalidCode: That isn't a Vromon friend code.
friends.qrLabel: Your QR code. Your friend code is {{code}}
friends.myCodeHint: Friends can scan this or type your code.
friends.shareMessage: Add me on Vromon! My friend code is {{code}}. Open {{link}} or enter the code in Friends → Add friend.
friends.regenerateBody: Your old QR code and invite links will stop working. Your friends stay friends.
friends.codeNotFoundBody: It may have been regenerated. Ask your friend for their current code.
friends.removeBody: You'll stop seeing each other's maps, stats, photos and trips. You can add each other again later.
friends.blockBody: You'll stop being friends, and they won't be able to find you or send you requests. They aren't told.

friends.emptyPoint1: Chat only with people you've added

road.title: On the road

settings.title: Settings
settings.discoverable: Let people find me by username
settings.signOutConfirmBody: Your trips stay in your account.
settings.pushUnavailable: Push isn't set up in this build yet

chats.title: Chats and privacy
chats.readReceiptsNote: Friends see when you've read their messages. It works both ways: with it off, you won't see theirs either.
chats.previewsNote: With it off, a notification only says who wrote.
chats.liveTitle: Only in trip rooms, only while you share it
chats.liveBody: On a trip that's happening today, you can share where you are with the trip's room. It stops when you tap Stop or when the time you chose runs out. Only your latest point is kept, never a history.
chats.clearBody: Every chat is emptied for you. The other people keep their messages. This can't be undone.
chats.clearNote: The download is your data export (a JSON file); your chats are in it.
chats.shareTripsNote: Friends see where you're travelling now and in the next two weeks, and your trips on your profile. Off hides them all. A trip you send in a chat still opens.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your travel map, trips and friends.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Your travel map and trips, on every device.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this phone to finish signing up.
auth.resent: Sent again. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. Open it on this phone.
auth.callbackFailedBody: It may have expired, or been opened on a different device. Request a new one.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't set up in this build.

onboarding.usernameBody: Friends find you by it. You can change it later.

problems.characters: Use only letters, numbers, dots and underscores
problems.dots: Dots can't be first, last or next to each other

onboarding.countryBody: Optional. It's shown on your profile.
onboarding.visitedBody: Tap the countries you've visited. You can add more on the map anytime.

profile.photoNote: Everyone who sees your profile sees your photo. It's stored on ImgBB.
profile.photoFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
profile.cameraDenied: Allow Vromon to use the camera in your phone's settings.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your profile, your travel map, your trips and itineraries, your settings and your sign-in. It can't be undone.

photos.title: Photos
photos.loadFailed: Photos couldn't load. Try again later.
photos.privacyHint: Location data is removed from your photos. Only you and your friends can see them.
photos.failedBody_one: {{count}} photo couldn't be uploaded. Tap it to try again.
photos.failedBody_other: {{count}} photos couldn't be uploaded. Tap them to try again.
photos.deleteBody: It's removed for you and your friends.

plan.buildBody: Vromon picks places for your interests and budget, checks their opening hours and fits them into each day.
plan.notPlanned: This trip has no plan yet.
plan.legBoatNote: No road goes there. Boat times are estimates: check the local schedule at the ghat.
plan.legA11y: Travel to the next stop: about {{time}}, {{km}} kilometres
plan.straightLine: Travel times are straight-line estimates, not road routes.
plan.emptyDay: Nothing is planned for this day: no other place fits it.
plan.budgetA11y: Budget: {{spent}} of {{total}} planned. Opens the budget.
plan.changeAllHint: Changes every day. Your must-sees stay.
plan.newIdeasBody: Day {{n}} is rebuilt with different places. Must-visit places stay; other days don’t change.
plan.rebuildBody: Every day is planned again, and your changes to this plan are replaced.
plan.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the trip, its plan and its photos. Photos you also added to a place stay there.
plan.swapHint: Places that fit {{from}}–{{to}}: open then, short enough for the gap, and not already in your trip.
plan.swapNone: No other place fits this time.
plan.swapMustVisit: This is a must-visit place, so it can’t be swapped.
plan.explainOff: More detail isn’t available right now. The reasons above still apply.
plan.explainNone: There isn’t enough source information to say more about this place.
plan.undoneOrder: Order put back; times worked out again
plan.keepTimeHint: Stays put when the day or the plan changes
plan.dragHint: Press and hold to move it
plan.dropOnDay: Drop on a day to move it there
plan.noSuggestions: No other places to add in {{dest}}.
plan.legSheet: How to get to the next stop
plan.legLeaveEstimate: Leave {{time}} · about {{km}} km in a straight line
plan.legEstimates: Road distance and driving time come from OpenStreetMap roads. Rickshaw and CNG times and all fares are estimates from local speeds and fares, and there's no live traffic yet.
plan.legReset: Vromon chooses how to get to {{to}}
plan.gettingNote: A rough estimate, not a timetable or a fare

newTrip.title: New trip

newTrip.pickFirst: Tap the first day of the trip
newTrip.mustDosHint: Optional. Your plan keeps these, or tells you why one can't fit.
newTrip.mustSeeHint: Choose a day and a time
newTrip.stepLeave: Finished the last day before you leave ({{time}})
newTrip.stepFillAny: Filled the rest with the best places
newTrip.failedSaved: Your trip is saved. You can try again, or build it later from the trip.
newTrip.sourcesNote: Places for the newer destinations come from Wikivoyage and Wikidata and haven't been checked yet: many prices and opening hours are unknown.

search.coverage_other: Vromon can plan trips to {{n}} destinations so far.

conditions.noForecast: The forecast couldn't be fetched yet. Sunrise and sunset are worked out from the date.
conditions.noSea: No beach or boat stop this day

w.traffic: Traffic may make you late for {{place}}

b.stormBoat: Affects stop {{n}}, {{place}}. Boats may not run in a storm.
b.wind: Affects stop {{n}}, {{place}}. Boats may not run in strong wind.
b.roughSea: Waves around {{wave}} m. Don't swim past the lifeguard flags.
b.afterDark: Sunset is {{sunset}}; you'd be there until {{end}}.
b.traffic: Usual traffic adds about {{extra}} min, and it closes at {{closes}}. This is usual traffic, not live.

src.sun: Source: sunset time for the date
src.traffic: Source: usual traffic in Bangladesh towns, not live

c.hoursOk_one: Your stop is open when you arrive.
c.hoursOk_other: All {{n}} stops are open when you arrive.

c.trafficNo: Some legs are in the usual {{when}} traffic: they show how much longer they take. Not live.

conditions.disclaimer: Vromon warns you using the data above. It can't promise that a place or a road is safe.
conditions.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh. Showing the last forecast.
conditions.allGoodHint: No rain, storms, rough sea or traffic problems expected at your stops.

seaWords.rough: Rough · waves around {{wave}} m. Stay near the shore.

budget.close: Only {{amount}} left. Prices with ≈ are estimates.
budget.mightGoOver: {{amount}} left, but the estimates could reach {{high}}.
budget.over: {{amount}} over your budget. See the ways to save below.
budget.noOrigin: Add where you start from to see this
budget.noHotel: No hotel data for this place yet
budget.foodSome: Meals for {{days}}, {{who}} · some prices are estimates
budget.ticketsFree_one: Entry and activities · {{n}} stop is free
budget.ticketsFree_other: Entry and activities · {{n}} stops are free
budget.byDayNote: Food, tickets and local travel. Getting there and the stay are counted once above.
budget.noSaves: Nothing in this plan to save on.
budget.saveRickshaw_one: Rickshaw instead of CNG for {{n}} short ride
budget.saveRickshaw_other: Rickshaw instead of CNG for {{n}} short rides
budget.footnote: ≈ marks estimates: fares are bargained and there are no timetables. Other prices come from Vromon's data and aren't quotes.

today.title: Today
today.noNext: No more stops to go to today.
today.lateTitle: Push the rest of the day back
today.lateNothing: Nothing has to move: there's free time to cover it.

why.day_ends: it would end after your day ({{end}})

today.useLocationSub: Only while this screen is open. It stays on your phone: never saved or sent.
today.locationDenied: Location is off for Vromon. You can allow it in the phone's settings.
today.remindWeather: Tell me the evening before if bad weather is coming
today.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off for Vromon. You can allow them in the phone's settings.
today.footnote: Times come from the clock and your plan. Traffic is the usual pattern, not live. With location on, “leave by” starts from where you are; your location is never saved or sent.
today.remindLeaveBody: Leave by {{leave}}: {{mode}}, about {{time}}. Your visit starts at {{start}}.
today.remindWeatherMore_one: And {{n}} more. Open Vromon to see your day.
today.remindWeatherMore_other: And {{n}} more. Open Vromon to see your day.
today.far: You're far from {{place}}, so this is from your plan.
today.exactHint: For reminders on time, allow “Alarms & reminders” for Vromon in the phone's settings.
